comment: Claudius's Process page (Git Crafter templates/process/config.json; keys: actions/pages/action.yml). Its maps are the pack's own, maps/guard.json and maps/decide.json, named by use. CI builds the page from quality/public/process.json, which quality/public.mjs writes from this file: each pack map in full, each step whose metric needs local files left out, and a map with no step left out too.
